summary: Wrote dft/dft_plan.md (Phase 0, plan only): test strategy, full-scan approach, proposed test pins, expected coverage method, memory test approach (none present), and open-flow limitations. No tools were run and no coverage number is claimed.
assumptions: Design has no memories or macros; derived from arch.yaml module list.
Flop count is unknown from the inputs, so scan chain length is left to be determined at insertion.
No latches, gated or generated clocks; taken from arch.yaml and not verified on the netlist.
Scan pins are proposed only; spec.yaml has none and adding them needs human approval.
The ATPG coverage targets are not stated in the plan, to avoid any coverage claim.
open_issues: Adding scan_en/scan_in/scan_out/test_mode (or sharing existing pins) is a spec interface change needing human decision at G1.
Scan-shift hold timing: fast-corner pre-layout hold slack is already slightly negative in synth_tool.json; scan will need hold fixing in PnR.
Whether synthesis can map to sky130 scan flops was not checked.

self_assessment.reason: Content follows the inputs and the six required sections; the checks that the runtime runs on section presence and absence of coverage numbers have not been seen by me.
